sources.title: Housing Health and Safety Rating System (HHSRS) guidance
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: The 2026 HHSRS suite covers 21 hazards and revised assessment/enforcement guidance; an exact dwelling assessment remains required.

sources.title: Housing Health and Safety Rating System (HHSRS): Operating guidance
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: Statutory operating guidance defines how assessors inspect and score hazards; it does not provide a candidate score without inspection.

sources.title: Housing Health and Safety Rating System (HHSRS): Enforcement guidance
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: Category 1 and category 2 enforcement powers follow a property-specific HHSRS assessment and cannot be inferred from location.

sources.title: Housing Health and Safety Rating System (HHSRS): Landlord and agent guide
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: The landlord guide explains duties and assessment principles but is not evidence of a hazard in any sample property.

sources.title: Housing Health and Safety Rating System (HHSRS): Tenant guide
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: The tenant guide explains inspections and council action; it does not establish a complaint, inspection or hazard at a candidate.

sources.title: Housing Health and Safety Rating System (HHSRS): Case studies
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: Worked scenarios are benchmarking examples for assessors and are not transferable parcel hazard scores.

sources.title: Local authority enforcement powers under the Housing Act 2004
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: Housing Act enforcement powers depend on an actual hazard assessment and responsible-person facts.

sources.title: Damp and mould: understanding and addressing the health risks for rented housing providers
sources.verified_claim: Damp and mould guidance sets health and landlord responsibilities but does not establish physical condition at any sample parcel.
